verification_methodology_note: PRIMARY SOURCE: ZATCA's own official consolidated Arabic PDF (zatca.gov.sa/ar/RulesRegulations/Taxes/Documents/... , locally saved as ZATCA_ZakatRegulation_1445_official.pdf, 62 pages, 128 articles across 5 أبواب / 16 فصول / 15 فروع) is the SOLE primary source for this track's 128 articles -- STATUS constant ZATCA_PDF_PRIMARY_SINGLE_SOURCE_GAZETTE_SPOT_VERIFIED reflects this: single-authority-source for full-text coverage, with the Umm Al-Qura Gazette portal (uqn.gov.sa) used only for targeted spot-verification (confirmed reachable this pass, contrary to this corpus's usual egress-blocked/503 experience with laws.boe.gov.sa, which was retried this pass and again returned HTTP 503 -- see known_unresolved_discrepancies). This is a DISTINCT and WEAKER verification tier than this corpus's cross-verified tracks (e.g. income_tax's 4-source BOE x ZATCA x GSTC x nezams.com tier): no second full-text government copy of this specific 128-article regulation was located or cross-checked word-for-word this pass. EXTRACTION METHODOLOGY -- this PDF's font/ToUnicode-CMap carries a confirmed, systematic character-transposition bug distinct from (and more severe than) the NFKC-normalizable Presentation-Forms issue documented in this corpus's income_tax track: wherever the genuine text has LAM immediately followed by any alef form (bare ا, or hamza-bearing أ/إ/آ -- i.e. the mandatory Arabic 'لا' ligature glyph), extraction (confirmed identical across pdftotext -layout, pdftotext -raw, and PyMuPDF/fitz, i.e. baked into the PDF itself, not a tool artifact) emits the two characters TRANSPOSED. This silently corrupts extremely common words (e.g. correct الأصول -> extracted الأصول with أ/ل swapped, i.e. 68 occurrences; الإقرار 66 occurrences; الآتية 45 occurrences; اللائحة -> الالئحة 119 occurrences) as well as rarer ones (خلال -> خالل; الإفلاس -> الإفالس; اللاحقة -> الالحقة, etc.). Fixed via a purpose-built normalizer (scripts/gen_zakat_law_track.py's embedded fix logic, ported from an iteratively-audited scratch script) combining: (1) a general regex for the 'ال + hamza-initial-noun' boundary case (confirmed safe -- no genuine Arabic root collides with this exact transposed pattern), applied first; (2) a curated ~140-entry whole-word dictionary for internal (non-boundary) لا-ligature corruptions, built by auditing every non-initial 'ال'/'أل'/'إل'/'آل' substring in the document and classifying it genuine (alef-then-lam order, e.g. المالية، حال، أعمال، صالح، مخالفة، تكاليف -- untouched) vs. corrupted (lam-then-alef order, e.g. اللائحة، خلال، الافتراض، اللازمة -- fixed); (3) context-anchored phrase substitutions for two genuinely ambiguous homograph families that collapse to the same corrupted surface form and cannot be resolved by dictionary alone: ثالث/ثالثة (ordinal 'third', genuine alef-lam, the overwhelming majority given this law's heavy use of ordinal article/chapter numbering) vs. ثلاثة (cardinal 'three', lam-alef, corrupted to the same surface form) -- resolved by reading each of 47 occurrences in context (2 are genuinely cardinal: '183' spelled out, and 'three non-consecutive installments' in Article 119); and مالك (singular 'owner', genuine) vs. ملاك (plural 'owners', lam-alef, corrupted to the same surface form) -- resolved by context per occurrence (all confirmed singular, matching the defined term مالك الوحدة used throughout, EXCEPT Article 13's title, independently confirmed as plural 'تغير الملاك والشكل النظامي' via a direct Umm Al-Qura Gazette fetch -- see known_unresolved_discrepancies); (4) a standalone-token rule recognizing that a freestanding 'ال' (space-delimited on both sides) is never a genuine definite article (which always attaches without a space) and is always a corrupted 'لا' negation particle (64 occurrences, all confirmed in context, e.g. 'على سبيل المثال لا الحصر', 'لا يجوز'). Arabic tashkeel (diacritics) -- present heavily and inconsistently throughout this PDF's text layer -- is stripped for consistency with this corpus's established undiacritized-Arabic convention. LINE-ORDER ARTIFACT (separate from the character-level bug above): this PDF's justified-text layout causes pdftotext to occasionally misorder wrapped lines, most commonly (a) a numbered/lettered list item's opening marker ('1.' or 'أ-') appearing on a line AFTER the sentence fragment it introduces, and (b) a lettered sub-item marker appearing at the END of its own line instead of the start. Both patterns were fixed generally (automated marker-detection reordering, applied to all 128 articles); a further ~35 articles required fully hand-reconstructed text where 2-3 line fragments were scrambled in a way the general reordering pass could not resolve (verified by reading the full sentence for sense -- no wording was added or removed, only reordered). A residual, unquantified risk of minor un-corrected word-order artifacts in a small number of paragraphs cannot be fully ruled out without a second independent full-text source to diff against.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: The foundational enabling Royal Decree 17/2/28/8634 (29/6/1370H), which establishes that Saudi/GCC-owned persons pay Zakat per Sharia while non-Saudis are governed by the (separately-covered, since-repealed) income tax decree, is described only in prose in preamble_ar. Its exact ~2-article verbatim text was only ever found via search-engine-mediated quotes (mohamyeh.com/nezams.com); direct fetches of both failed again this pass. Per zero-fabrication policy this 2-article text is NOT transcribed as verbatim content and is NOT a numbered article of this track.

Unlike this corpus's cross-verified tracks (income_tax: 4 sources; VAT; etc.), this track's full 128-article text rests on ZATCA's own PDF as the sole full-text source. laws.boe.gov.sa was retried this pass (both a targeted URL and a fresh site-search) and again returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, matching this corpus's established pattern of BOE unreachability for other tracks -- documented as a confirmed gap, not bypassed via any hostname trick. The Umm Al-Qura Gazette portal (uqn.gov.sa) WAS successfully reached this pass (contrary to the prior research pass's assumption) and used for targeted spot-verification of specific facts (the resolution number/date and Article 13's title), but not for a full second copy of the 128-article body text to diff word-for-word against ZATCA's PDF.

No explicit repeal clause naming the prior Zakat Collection Implementing Regulation (Ministerial Resolution 2216, 7/7/1440H) was found within the operative 128-article body text itself. Supersession is corroborated by (a) ZATCA site metadata and (b) a WebFetch-tool summary (not a verbatim quote) of the Umm Al-Qura Gazette's page for Resolution 1007 stating it 'replaces the previous executive regulation from 1440H and all related prior decisions' -- but since that summary was produced by an intermediate small-model summarizer rather than read verbatim by this pass, it is treated as corroborating context only, not as a verified quotation.

Ministerial Resolution No. 1007, dated 19/8/1445H, is now confirmed via a DIRECT successful fetch of the Umm Al-Qura Gazette portal (uqn.gov.sa/details?p=24721), an upgrade from the prior research pass's search-engine-mediated-only confidence. A companion Gazette page (p=24722, hosting the regulation's own text) separately shows a Gazette PUBLICATION date of 11/9/1445H (21 March 2024G) -- a distinct, later date from the resolution's own issuance date, consistent with normal publication lag; both dates are recorded here rather than conflated. Note that WebFetch summarizes page content via an intermediate small model rather than returning raw HTML, so this remains a strong corroboration rather than a pixel-perfect primary-source quotation.

A secondary claim of 200,000/400,000 SAR minimum zakat-base figures, flagged as unconfirmed by the prior research pass, was searched for again across the full 128-article text this pass and is CONFIRMED ABSENT. The only flat-amount floor found anywhere in the regulation is Article 86's 500 SAR minimum zakat for presumptive (مكلف تقديري) taxpayers, and Article 124's 300,000 SAR seizure-exemption floor for a taxpayer's personal/business-necessity effects (a different provision entirely, not a zakat-base floor). The 200k/400k claim should be treated as unsupported by the primary source and must not be attributed to this regulation.

Article 13's title is corrupted in raw extraction to a garbled, font-mangled fragment ambiguous between المالك (singular 'the owner') and الملاك (plural 'the owners'). Resolved as الملاك (plural) via a direct WebFetch of the Umm Al-Qura Gazette (uqn.gov.sa/details?p=24722), which returned the title verbatim as "تغير الملاك والشكل النظامي". All other مالك/ملاك occurrences throughout the 128 articles were resolved as singular مالك by context (matching the defined term مالك الوحدة used consistently throughout the Fund-related articles).

This PDF's font/ToUnicode-CMap systematically transposes LAM+alef-form character pairs (the mandatory 'لا' ligature, in all four alef forms ا/أ/إ/آ) across the entire 128-article text -- far more pervasive than the Presentation-Forms issue documented in this corpus's income_tax track, since it silently corrupts extremely common vocabulary (الأصول 68x, الإقرار 66x, الآتية 45x, اللائحة 119x, etc.) not just rare ligature-heavy words. See verification_methodology_note for the full fix methodology (general regex + ~140-entry curated dictionary + context-anchored fixes for two genuine homograph ambiguities). A residual risk that some low-frequency (1-2 occurrence) corrupted word-forms were not individually audited cannot be fully excluded, though the systematic full-document scan this pass found no further unaddressed instances of the bug's two known signature patterns (اال.../ا[أإآ]ل...) after all fixes were applied.

Separately from the character-level ligature bug, this PDF's justified text layout caused pdftotext to misorder some wrapped lines (list-item markers appearing after their own text, or 2-3 line fragments within a single sub-clause appearing out of logical order). An automated marker-position reordering pass fixed the general pattern across all 128 articles; ~35 articles additionally required fully hand-reconstructed text (verified by reading the complete sentence for sense; no wording added or removed, only reordered) where the automated pass could not resolve a deeper scramble. A residual, unquantified risk of minor uncorrected word-order artifacts in a small number of paragraphs not individually flagged during this review cannot be fully excluded without a second full-text source to diff against.

Article 73 (real-estate-under-construction / off-plan-sale zakat treatment) is the sole معدلة article, amended by Ministerial Resolution 1248 dated 11/10/1446H. ZATCA's consolidated PDF shows only the CURRENT (post-amendment) text, with the amendment note itself found embedded mid-sentence in the raw extraction (confirming the resolution number/date verbatim from the primary source, extracted to Article 73's history entry). No pre-amendment (original) text of Article 73 was recovered from any source checked this pass; original_1445h_text is not populated for this article -- a documented gap, not a fabrication.

The GSTC explanatory guide saved to scratchpad (gstc_guide.txt / GSTC_explanatory_guide_base_law.pdf) covers the PRIOR/predecessor zakat regime and was used only as background context during research, never as a source for any of this track's 128 operative article texts, all of which rest solely on ZATCA's own 1445H-regulation PDF.

**تحفُّظ على سلامة النص**: يحمل 3 سجلاً من 128 في هذا المسار أثر انقلاب رابطة لام-ألف في النص العربي — «االطلاع» موضع «الاطلاع»، و«اإلدارية» موضع «الإدارية»، و«إعالن» موضع «إعلان»، و«الالزمة» موضع «اللازمة».

**ومنشأ الخلل لم يُختبر في هذا المسار**: لا يستشهد المسار بملف PDF بعينه يمكن إعادة جلبه واستخراجه، فلا يُقال هنا أهو في المصدر أم في القراءة. وقد ثبت في مسارين آخرين من مسارات هذا المستودع أن الطبقة النصية للملف الرسمي هي التي تحمله (scripts/verify_pdf_source_encoding.py)، وهي قرينة لا دليل على هذا المسار بعينه.

**ولم يُصحَّح حرف واحد.** الانقلاب **يُحوِّل كلمات عربية صحيحة إلى كلمات عربية صحيحة أخرى**: «العالقة» (المُعلَّقة) قلبُ «العلاقة»، و«عالمة» (التي تعلم) قلبُ «علامة»، و«صالحية» قلبُ «صلاحية» — و«الشوائب **العالقة** ببدن السفينة» و«القضايا **العالقة** لدى المحامين» صوابٌ يقول ما يعنيه. فلا قاعدةَ آليةٌ تفصل العطب عن الصواب؛ الفصل يحتاج الجملة لا الرسم. وجُرِّب إصلاحٌ مشروطٌ بأن يكون الشكل المُصحَّح مشهوداً في نصوص المستودع السليمة فأخفق: الاستخراج يشطر الكلمة أيضاً («خ اال المدة» وأصلها «خلال المدة»)، وبعض «الشواهد» عطبٌ مماثل تسرَّب إلى مسارٍ آخر.

المُفصَح عنه أن **رسم بعض الكلمات في هذه السجلات لا يطابق الرسم الصحيح** وإن بقي المعنى مقروءاً، فلا يصح النسخ الحرفي منها قبل المقابلة بالصفحة المطبوعة. ورفعُ هذا التحفُّظ يكون بنسخٍ بشريٍّ من الصفحة المُصيَّرة، لا بقاعدة ولا بإعادة استخراج. (رصدَه scripts/audit_corpus_text_integrity.py)
